name: System Lab tokens
description: Combines reference, semantic and component token sets with a light/dark theme modifier. Read by scripts/tokens/build-tokens.mjs.

reference.description: Raw scales and palettes. Never consumed directly by components.

semantic.description: Theme-independent roles: focus geometry, control sizing, layout rhythm, typography.

component.description: A few deliberate component extension points that alias semantic roles.

theme.description: Color theme. Both contexts must define the same semantic color roles.
